info.name: PayBack API
info.description:
PayBack - Informal Roommate IOU Tracker
Student: Arshdeep Singh | Student #: 9042880
Course: PROG2500 - Open-Source Full Stack Development
Professor: John Prinz

Base URL: https://payback-api.onrender.com

How to use protected endpoints:
1. Use 'Register User' or 'Login User' to get a JWT token
2. Copy the 'token' value from the response
3. In the collection Variables tab, set 'token' to that value
4. All protected endpoints automatically use Bearer {{token}}

variable.description: Live API base URL on Render
JWT token - paste here after login/register

item.name: Auth
item.description: Public endpoints for user registration and login. No token required.

request.description:
Register a new user account.

Body fields:
- name (string, required)
- email (string, required, must be valid email)
- password (string, required, min 6 characters)

Password is hashed with bcrypt before storage. Plain-text password is NEVER stored.

Expected Status: 201 Created
Returns: JWT token + user info (no password)

Login with email and password.

Body fields:
- email (string, required)
- password (string, required)

Expected Status: 200 OK
Returns: JWT token + user info

Copy the 'token' from the response and set it as the 'token' collection variable.

item.name: Users
item.description: User endpoints. All routes require a valid JWT token in the Authorization header.

request.description:
Get a list of all registered users.

Password hash is NEVER included in the response.

Use this to find the user_id needed for the 'borrower_id' when creating an IOU.

Expected Status: 200 OK
Returns: Array of users (user_id, name, email, created_at)

Get a single user by their ID.

Expected Status: 200 OK
If user does not exist: 404 Not Found

item.name: IOUs
item.description:
IOU (Resource A) CRUD endpoints. All routes require a valid JWT token.

Full CRUD: GET all, GET by ID, POST create, PUT update, DELETE.

request.description:
Get all IOUs where the authenticated user is the lender OR borrower.

Returns two lists:
- owedToMe: IOUs where you are the lender
- iOwe: IOUs where you are the borrower

Also returns a summary with total amounts.

Expected Status: 200 OK

Get a single IOU by ID, including full payment history.

Expected Status: 200 OK
If not found: 404 Not Found
If user is not the lender or borrower: 403 Forbidden

Create a new IOU. The authenticated user becomes the lender automatically.

Body fields:
- borrower_id (integer, required) - use GET /api/users to find IDs
- amount (number, required, must be > 0)
- reason (string, required)

Users table is linked to IOURecords via lender_id and borrower_id Foreign Keys.

Expected Status: 201 Created
If borrower not found: 404 Not Found
If trying to create IOU with yourself: 400 Bad Request

Update an existing IOU. Only the lender can update.

Body fields (all optional, at least one required):
- amount (number, must be > 0)
- reason (string)
- status ('Unpaid' or 'Paid')

Expected Status: 200 OK
If not found: 404 Not Found
If not the lender: 403 Forbidden

Delete an IOU. Only the lender can delete. Cannot be deleted if payments already exist.

Expected Status: 200 OK
If not found: 404 Not Found
If not the lender: 403 Forbidden
If payments exist: 400 Bad Request

item.name: Payments
item.description:
Payment (Resource B) CRUD endpoints. All routes require a valid JWT token.

Full CRUD: GET all for IOU, POST create, PUT update, DELETE.

Payments are linked to IOURecords via the iou_id Foreign Key (One-to-Many relationship).

query.description: The ID of the IOU to get payments for

request.description:
Get all payments for a specific IOU.

Query params:
- iou_id (integer, required)

Expected Status: 200 OK
If IOU not found: 404 Not Found
If not lender or borrower: 403 Forbidden

Record a payment on an IOU.

Body fields:
- iou_id (integer, required)
- payment_amount (number, required, must be > 0)

If the full amount is paid, the IOU status is automatically set to 'Paid'.

Expected Status: 201 Created
If IOU not found: 404 Not Found
If payment exceeds balance: 400 Bad Request

Update the amount of an existing payment.

Body fields:
- payment_amount (number, required, must be > 0)

Expected Status: 200 OK
If not found: 404 Not Found
If not authorized: 403 Forbidden
If amount exceeds remaining balance: 400 Bad Request

Delete a payment record. If the IOU was marked 'Paid', it is automatically reset to 'Unpaid'.

Expected Status: 200 OK
If not found: 404 Not Found
If not authorized: 403 Forbidden
